title: Night Cream for Teenagers: At What Age to Start and What to Use
ex: Most teens need only a cleanser, a light moisturiser and sunscreen. Learn when to start night cream and which strong actives to skip under 18.
rt: Night Cream for Teenagers: When to Start | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for teenagers: at what age to start night cream, a simple teen routine, actives to skip under 18, acne-prone skin tips and when to see a doctor.
quick: Most teenagers do not need a special night cream. A gentle cleanser and a light, simple moisturiser at night are enough. There is no fixed age to start; begin when skin feels dry by morning, and avoid strong actives under 18 unless a doctor advises them.
facts: There is no fixed age to start night cream
A teen routine needs only cleanser, moisturiser and sunscreen
Skip retinoids, strong acids and kojic acid under 18 unless a doctor advises
Painful or cystic acne needs a dermatologist
